NONE: › objects that, when they were produced, were not intended to last a long time or were specially produced for one occasion
只在短期內有用的事物；短暫存在的事物；一次性的事物

example: Amongst other pop ephemera, the auction will be selling off rock stars' stage clothes.
拍賣會拍賣的流行樂壇的短期過時物品中將包括搖滾歌星們的演出服裝。

NONE: › lasting for only a short time
短暫的，極短的；轉瞬即逝的

example: Fame in the world of rock and pop is largely ephemeral.
在搖滾和流行音樂界，名聲大多轉瞬即逝。
